Invoice#unpaid_for.summary: Returns the bills belonging to one client that have no payment recorded against them, oldest first.

Invoice#settle!.summary: Marks a bill as having been paid at a given moment and tells the client it went through.

Invoice#total_cents.summary: Adds up every line on a bill, multiplying each quantity by its per-unit price, and returns the whole amount in cents.

Invoice#overdue?.summary: Answers whether a bill is both unpaid and already past the day it was meant to be settled.

Receipt#outstanding.summary: Returns the records for one purchaser that still carry no payment, oldest first.

Receipt#total_cents.summary: Adds up every entry, multiplying each quantity by its per-unit price, and returns the whole amount in cents.

Account#authenticate.summary: Checks a secret phrase against the stored one-way hash, refusing outright if the account is not in good standing.

Account#lock!.summary: Bars an account from further use, recording when and why, and writes the action to the audit trail.

Account#active?.summary: Answers whether an account is neither barred nor still awaiting confirmation.

Account#display_name.summary: Joins whatever parts of a person's name are present into a single string fit for showing.

Session#authenticate.summary: Checks a presented credential string against the stored one-way hash, refusing outright if the session is no longer live.

Session#expire!.summary: Ends a live session ahead of time, recording when and why, and writes the action to the audit trail.

Polygon#area.summary: Computes how much flat space a closed shape encloses from the coordinates of its corners.

Polygon#perimeter.summary: Adds the straight-line distance between each pair of neighbouring corners to get the length of the boundary.

Polygon#centroid.summary: Averages the corner coordinates to find the balancing point of a shape.

Trail#length.summary: Adds the straight-line distance between each pair of neighbouring points to get the total distance covered.

Warehouse#reserve.summary: Sets aside a quantity of an item for a short window, refusing if there is not enough uncommitted stock.

Warehouse#available.summary: Reports how much of an item could still be committed, by subtracting live holds from what is physically on hand.

Warehouse#restock.summary: Increases the recorded on-hand quantity for an item, starting a record for it if none exists.

Depot#available.summary: Reports how much of an item could still be committed, by subtracting live holds from what is physically on hand.

Depot#reserve.summary: Sets aside a quantity of an item for a short window, refusing if there is not enough uncommitted stock.

Dispatcher#send_reminder.summary: Emails an overdue notice, trying again after a growing pause when the mail server rejects it, and giving up after the third attempt.

Dispatcher#rates.summary: Returns exchange rates keyed by currency code, computing them on the first call and reusing that result afterwards.

Dispatcher#close.summary: Marks an accounting period closed, and does nothing if it was already closed, so repeating the call changes nothing.
